description: This Java class, LinkAccountsToPocketCommandHandler, handles a command to link accounts to a 'pocket' within the Apache Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a service, and processes commands by invoking the linkAccounts method on the PocketWritePlatformService.

classes.name: LinkAccountsToPocketCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles commands to link accounts to a pocket; processes JSON commands using the associated service.

methods.name: LinkAccountsToPocketCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the PocketWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command processing by calling the linkAccounts method of the service.
